issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: dandelion, cornflower, moss_carpet, lectern, target, carved_pumpkin, red_banner.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.artefacts: The drill master's shelter roof (spruce slabs y=3, x=1..3, z=6..8) stands on two fence posts at its front only (x=1 and x=3, z=6); the back half hangs over the lectern with no support.
notes.shape: The shelter adds a second height and asymmetry.
notes.life: Flower bed along the front, moss carpet, flowers, lanterns.

visual.summary: L2 plus a drill master's shelter with lectern and hanging lantern, a flower bed along the front curb and moss; the most complete and lively level.
problems: Shelter roof unsupported at the back: add spruce fence posts at (x=1, y=2, z=8) and (x=3, y=2, z=8) (the stair seat at x=1 and the lectern at x=2 can stay; move the seat if needed).
Hay block (x=0, z=0, y=0) and barrel (x=8, z=0, y=0) capping the outside flower bed look stuck on; a trapdoor edge or a log end would tie the bed into the curb better.
Reach: one enclosed floor tile at (x=1, y=1, z=5) between the barrel, dummy pole and shelter post is unreachable (harmless); shelter roof top and target tops unreached (fine).
